meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 装上后,它会把这个项目接入 Matrix 聊天(房间或私信),不限制用哪家 Matrix 服务器;装好通道后,会引导你准备一个与你本人账号分开的机器人账号并填写登录信息。
howto.when: 当用户想让当前项目加上 Matrix 聊天通道,例如要连房间或私信时,它会接管处理。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目接上 Matrix 聊天。
say.note: 会开始接入并做安装检查。

say.text: 用用户名密码方式给机器人配置,服务器用 matrix.org。
say.note: 会让你依次填服务器、用户 ID、显示名等凭据。

say.text: 配好后跑一下 /manage-channels 接上 agent 组。
say.note: 把 Matrix 通道绑定到对应分组。

howto.what_en: Once installed, it can connect this project to Matrix chat (rooms or DMs) on any Matrix homeserver. It adds and checks the channel, then guides you through setting up a bot account that is separate from your own account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to add a Matrix chat channel to the current project, such as connecting rooms or DMs on any Matrix homeserver.

say_en.text: Connect this project to Matrix chat.
say_en.note: Starts the channel install and checks.

say_en.text: Configure the bot with username and password on matrix.org.
say_en.note: Walks you through server, user ID, display name, and login.

say_en.text: After that, run /manage-channels to attach an agent group.
say_en.note: Binds the Matrix channel to a group.
